newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pertamina restarts Dumai cracker after April fire.
newsitem.headline: Pertamina restarts Dumai cracker after April fire.

text.p: Indonesia's state-owned Pertamina has restarted a 27,500 barrel-per-day (bpd) hydrocracker on March 20 after being shut for more than a month following a fire at the unit, sources close to the refinery said on Wednesday.
"The hydrocracker was re-started on March 20 and it is operating at 70 percent of capacity," the source said.
The hydrocracker was shutdown on April 11 after a pipeline feeding heavy fuel feedstock to the cracker caught fire.
Dumai's other 27,500 bpd hydrocracker and the 125,000 bpd crude distillation unit is operating at full capacity, the source said.
